definitions.nonprogressive_repetition: Same event, phrase or explanatory relation repeated without new progression; semantic paraphrases count. A repeated condition followed by its justified outcome or one echo before genuine new information alone does not count. Diagnostic observation, not a replacement for the original automatic repetition metric.
definitions.premise: maintained: central source situation/objects/constraints retained, even if later grammar or repetition fails. violated: concrete numeric/time/choice constraints or straightforward stated causal purpose reversed. unresolved: omitted response, abrupt topic/entity shift or ambiguity prevents deciding full premise retention; not evidence of literal contradiction or proof that fantasy is wrong.
